No source tests real sustained throughput on both chips, thermal throttling over a long transfer, TB3 compatibility quirks (several units need macOS 15+ or won't work on TB3 at all), or current prices and codes for OWC Express 1M2 80G vs Acasis TB501 Pro vs UGREEN 80Gbps vs TerraMaster D1 Pro.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all. The results are affiliate listicles (DeskFinds x2, PCPartsGeek x2, GearSift, two recycled-domain roundups), two brand product pages (TESmart, Acasis), and three niche pages with no testing: bitdoze has a dated price/compat table and a pick but ignores the base-M4-is-TB4 constraint, picklog explains that constraint from Apple's spec sheet but picks nothing and measures nothing, cloudzat shows one spec row. Nobody answers both halves ("worth it on my M4" and "which one") with checkable numbers. A focused page that states plainly which MacBook Pro M4 models have TB5, shows measured speeds on TB4 vs TB5 hosts, and ranks OWC/Acasis/UGREEN/TerraMaster with current prices and tested codes would stand out, as in the solar-kit win.
